messages:
Maya (CSM): Quick post-onboard notes from two fintech pilots today. Dropping raw asks so we can triage.
Owen (PM): thanks Maya  can you bullet the specific requests?
Maya (CSM): sure: 1) tenant-locked prompt templates (ability to "pin" approved prompts per account + export for audits) 2) a lightweight changelog/diff view when we promote a model variant or update prompts 3) much faster embedding index updates for small prompt changes (customers saw ~75-100s today)
Tori (Support): we already have a support ticket for a customer asking "what changed between model versions" they want diffs not just version numbers.
Sam (Eng): for 1) tenant-pinned prompts implies per-tenant prompt storage and RBAC. db schema change + API surface. 2) changelog diffs = small frontend feature + diffing backend (text diffs + sample-output snapshotting). 3) embedding refreshes under 30s for tiny datasets likely requires hot-reindex or streaming upserts into the vector store; depends on current index tech (we can implement a push endpoint to accelerate small batches).
Owen (PM): impact guesses? Maya, quick low/med/high from your calls please.
Maya (CSM): tenant-pinned prompts = HIGH (procurement + audit requirement). changelog/diffs = MED (reduces churn/anxiety). embedding refresh <30s = MED (onboarding automation breaks if slow).
Tori (Support): adding that the ticket mentions legal/audit teams want exportable prompt manifests.
Maya (CSM): also: one customer "Greenline" said they'd be open to a paid pilot for faster embedding turnaround. adding to triage.
Sam (Eng): quick mitigation idea: expose a /v1/embeddings/push-reindex endpoint that accepts small batches and triggers an immediate upsert into an in-memory write buffer then background-commit. Low-effort shim while we design streaming ingestion.
Owen (PM): next steps: - Maya add customer names & verbatim quotes to the triage page - Sam sketch rough S/M/L effort estimates - Tori link existing support ticket IDs - I'll review in prioritization sync
triage-bot: New triage card created by Maya (CSM)  https://notion.redwood/inbox/field-voice-1729997777  assigned to Owen (PM).
Maya (CSM): accounts: Greenline, MeridianPay. pasted quotes on the triage card.
Sam (Eng): ballpark: tenant storage + RBAC = Medium (DB + api + ui). changelog diffs = Small. push-reindex endpoint (rudimentary) = Small-Medium. full streaming index = Large.
Owen (PM): if engineering ballpark for a robust solution >2w we'll propose the push-reindex + doc workaround and offer Greenline a pilot.
Tori (Support): I'll draft KB steps for the push-reindex workaround with curl examples and attach to the triage card.
Maya (CSM): thanks team. react on the triage card if you want more raw transcripts. :thumbsup:
Owen (PM): will update after prioritization meeting. closing the loop here once we have direction.
